# Crowded Kingdoms APIs

> Crowded Kingdoms is a platform for massive multiplayer worlds. There are two public APIs: one GraphQL API serving both the management surface (identity, organizations, apps marketplace, access tiers, billing, payments, quotas) and the game surface (runtime world/replication data and the realtime UDP-proxy subscription stream), and the Replication API / "Buddy" (a binary UDP wire protocol for low-latency spatial replication). The management and game surfaces are ONE endpoint — there is no separate management host to configure. Browser clients should use the CrowdyJS TypeScript SDK. Passwordless sign-in produces an identity session token; mint a separate app-scoped token for gameplay and realtime calls. Apps live in a single datacenter, so mintAppToken and gameClientBootstrap return the endpoint to use for that app — follow it rather than hardcoding a host. BigInt values are decimal strings; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.

## Start here (for AI agents and integrators)

- [For AI agents — quickstart & end-to-end workflows](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/for-ai-agents): get a dev-tier key, the SDL/introspection URLs, and the most common flows (register → token → host discovery → spatial send; and the studio-backend economy flow).
- [Overview / client workflow](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/client-workflow): one endpoint, two token types, and how an app's datacenter endpoint is discovered.
- [Discord community support](https://discord.gg/x7tMKGwHf): ask questions and get help from the Crowded Kingdoms community.

## Schema (downloadable SDL)

- [Full SDL](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/schema/game-api.graphql) - the complete unified schema; start here.
- [Management-surface SDL](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/schema/management-api.graphql) - the same schema filtered to identity/orgs/apps/billing, for reading that surface alone.
- [CrowdyJS SDL](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/schema/crowdyjs.graphql)
- Introspection is enabled on the dev tier; the GraphQL Playground is served at the API's `/graphql` endpoint.

- [Operator runbook](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/operators/agentic-crowdy-studio): platform/app kills, secret injection, freshness monitoring, incident procedure, and purge.
